plugins.name: mission
plugins.description: Structured execution framework for long-horizon coding tasks, built on Boyd's OODA loop. Decomposes projects into milestones with validation gates, fresh context per step, and file-based state that survives compaction.

skills.name: continue
skills.description: Resume a mission from the last completed milestone. Use after /clear, in a new session, or when context is getting long. Reads plan and progress from .mission/ files and picks up where you left off.
headings: 1. Observe — Read the state from disk
skills.description_zh: 读取 .mission/ 中的计划和进度，从最后完成的里程碑恢复任务；适用于清空上下文、新会话或上下文过长时继续执行。

skills.name: pivot
skills.description: Mid-flight mission plan adjustment. Use when the approach is wrong, requirements changed, a milestone needs splitting, or scope needs updating. Boyd's "destruction and creation" applied to the plan.
headings: 2. Destroy — Break apart the old plan
skills.description_zh: 在任务执行途中调整计划，处理路线不合适、需求变化、里程碑需拆分或范围需更新的情况。

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Interactive mission planning — research the codebase, ask clarifying questions, decompose work into milestones with acceptance criteria, and save an approved plan. Start here before /mission:start.
headings: Step 2: Orient — Probe for the full picture
Step 3: Orient deeper — Research the codebase
Step 4: Decide — Draft the mission plan
Step 5: Iterate — Test the plan against the user's orientation
Step 6: Act — Save the approved plan
skills.description_zh: 交互式规划任务：研究代码库、澄清需求，将工作拆成带验收标准的里程碑并保存批准后的计划，作为 mission:start 的前置步骤。

skills.name: start
skills.description: Begin executing an approved mission plan from milestone 1. Requires .mission/plan.md to exist. Runs milestones sequentially with validation gates between each. Use /mission:plan first.
headings: Mission Start — Enter the OODA Cycle
skills.description_zh: 从第一个里程碑开始顺序执行已批准的任务计划，并在里程碑之间设置验证关卡；要求已有 .mission/plan.md，先完成 mission:plan。

skills.name: status
skills.description: Show current mission progress — milestones completed, current milestone, remaining work, and any blockers. Pure observation, no execution.
skills.description_zh: 只读展示当前任务进度，包括已完成和当前里程碑、剩余工作与阻碍，不执行任务。

skills.name: validate
skills.description: Run acceptance criteria for the current milestone (or all milestones). Reports pass/fail. Pure observation — does not advance or fix anything.
skills.description_zh: 运行当前或全部里程碑的验收标准并报告通过或失败；只做检查，不推进里程碑或自动修复。
